page_title: UDI 1-1 ATA | Udinese v Atalanta 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Gianluca Aureliano has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' 1 - 1 Goal – 1:1! Davide Zappacosta sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Ederson (Atalanta) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom left corner.
90+2' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
89' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) commits a foul and Gianluca Aureliano immediately signals a free kick.
87' The referee awards a corner and Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) goes over to take it.
86' Gianluca Aureliano couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Festy Ebosele (Udinese) and blew his whistle.
83' Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul after Sandi Lovric (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
83' Substitution. Emil Holm is replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
83' Substitution. Lazar Samardzic will be replaced by Florian Thauvin (Udinese).
83' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Isaac Success is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
82' Substitution. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) in, Jordan Zemura out.
77' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
77' The game has come to an end for Joao Ferreira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
76' Foul! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
73' Walace (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Aureliano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
71' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Martin Payero will be replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).

70' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Aureliano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
67' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mitchel Bakker.
63' Martin Payero (Udinese) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
61' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Marco Carnesecchi stops the ball from going inside the left post. Udinese get a corner.
59' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
51' The substitution is prepared. Emil Holm (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hans Hateboer.
51' The corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.

49' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a brilliant save.
48' Isaac Success (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
47' Dangerous play by Joao Ferreira (Udinese). Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) has come on in place of Luis Muriel.
46' Half-time substitution. Mario Pasalic is replaced by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Walace (Udinese) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Marco Carnesecchi. He makes it 1:0.
42' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
39' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is cleared.
39' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
38' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
37' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
33' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
31' Isaac Success (Udinese) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
31' Isaac Success (Udinese) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
30' Referee Gianluca Aureliano sees the trip by Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Udinese!
26' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
25' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul.
24' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
20' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
19' The resulting corner from Luis Muriel (Atalanta) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
18' The resulting free kick from Luis Muriel (Atalanta) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
17' Rough tackle by Walace (Udinese). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
11' The game is interrupted as Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
6' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
4' Isaac Success (Udinese) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Aureliano stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Gianluca Aureliano.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
